output.reason: New heavier-than-spotting vaginal bleeding with lower abdominal cramping at about 8 weeks pregnant requires same-day in-person pelvic assessment, hCG and ultrasound today to exclude ectopic pregnancy, which messaging cannot do.
output.patientMessage: Please be seen in person today at an emergency department or early-pregnancy/OB service that can do an ultrasound and blood tests — bleeding heavier than spotting with cramping at 8 weeks needs hands-on assessment to rule out an ectopic pregnancy. Go to the emergency department immediately if you soak a pad an hour, faint, feel dizzy, or get severe or shoulder-tip pain. A Counsel clinician can help coordinate in this thread, but do not delay going.
differential: Threatened or in-progress early pregnancy loss
